summary.en: Muir is sold as pelleted lettuce seed. Johnny's gives pellet-specific moisture and storage guidance alongside crop-level lettuce germination information; those instructions are retained at the product scope.

guidance.en: Johnny's says initial watering should dissolve the pellet and moderate, consistent moisture should continue through germination. If the medium dries before emergence, the pelleted seed may receive too little moisture.

short.es: El ambiente fresco reduce el riesgo de dormancia térmica

guidance.en: Johnny's gives lettuce crop-level optimum germination soil temperatures of 60–68°F (15.5–20°C) and notes thermal dormancy at high temperatures. No Muir-specific number of germination days is stated here.
guidance.es: Johnny's indica temperaturas óptimas de suelo de 60–68°F (15,5–20°C) para germinación de lechuga y advierte dormancia térmica a temperaturas altas. Aquí no se indica un número de días específico de Muir.

short.es: Protege los pellets de cambios de humedad

guidance.en: Johnny's recommends using pelleted seed within one year and storing it cool, dark, and dry in an airtight container if refrigerated.
guidance.es: Johnny's recomienda usar la semilla peletizada dentro de un año y guardarla en lugar fresco, oscuro y seco; si se refrigera, usar un recipiente hermético.
